Query String Builder

Add key/value rows and get a properly percent-encoded query string for your URLs.

📖 How to use

  1. Add rows and type each parameter key and value.
  2. Optionally set a base URL.
  3. Click Build — the encoded query string appears below.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are special characters encoded?

Yes — keys and values are encoded with encodeURIComponent, so spaces, & and unicode are handled.

Does parameter order matter?

They are kept in the exact order you entered them.

What about empty keys or values?

Rows with an empty key are skipped. An empty value is kept as key= (no value).

Can I build a full URL?

Yes — fill in the optional base URL field and the string is appended to it.
